description: This file defines the login page component for a Next.js application using React. It includes a login form with email and password inputs, handles user authentication via Supabase, and manages redirect logic based on user role and session state.

methods.name: LoginInner
methods.description: React functional component that manages the login form, authentication logic, and auto-redirects upon successful login.

methods.name: LoginPage
methods.description: React component that wraps LoginInner with Suspense for loading fallback.
